bib.title: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers

question: Can self-attention be made sub-quadratic in sequence length, via sparse factorizations, while matching dense attention for density modeling of images, text and audio?
hypothesis: Factorized attention patterns that connect all positions over several steps can match the performance of the rich learned patterns of full attention.
contributions: Sparse factorizations of the attention matrix reducing cost to O(n sqrt n)
A restructured residual block and weight initialization for training deeper networks
Recomputation of attention matrices to save memory

method.summary: Decoder-only Transformer with pre-activation residual blocks and two factorized attention patterns (strided, fixed) with p=2 heads, trained autoregressively on raw bytes of CIFAR-10, Enwik8, ImageNet 64x64 and classical music audio. Uses gradient checkpointing of attention/FF blocks, custom block-sparse GPU kernels and mixed precision.
method.task: autoregressive density modeling of raw bytes (images, text, audio)

datasets.name: CIFAR-10
datasets.split: 48000 train, 2000 validation, best models evaluated on test set

datasets.name: Enwik8
datasets.split: first 90 million tokens train, last 10 million validation and test

datasets.name: ImageNet 64x64 (downsampled, Oord et al. 2016)
datasets.source: version released by Oord et al., 2016

datasets.name: Classical music (Dieleman et al. 2018)
datasets.preprocessing: mu-law encoded at 12 kHz; paper says details of the dataset processing are unavailable

models.name: Sparse Transformer 59M (strided), CIFAR-10
models.architecture: decoder-only, strided factorized attention, half-size FF and query-key projections

models.name: Sparse Transformer 95M (fixed), Enwik8
models.architecture: decoder-only, fixed attention, merged heads, stride 128, c=32

other.inferred: inferred: 64*64*3=12,288 bytes; paper does not state context for ImageNet
other.samples: also a 300M model with twice the layers

other.sizing: largest model that fits a 16GB V100 without model parallelism, per sequence length

training.objective: maximize log-probability of the data (autoregressive next-byte, softmax over v values)
training.precision: weights single-precision, activations and gradients half-precision, dynamic loss scaling; queries and keys cast to single-precision when sampling
training.dropout: 0.25 (CIFAR-10), 0.40 (Enwik8), 0.01 (ImageNet); applied only at end of each residual addition, none inside attention
training.hardware: 8 V100 GPUs unless noted; 64 V100 GPUs for ImageNet
training.seeds: 1, 2, 3 for CIFAR-10 and Enwik8; 1 run for ImageNet

other.init: token embedding N(0, 0.125/sqrt(d)); position embeddings N(0, 0.125/sqrt(d*n_emb)); weights N(0, 0.125/sqrt(d_in)); biases 0; output logit matrix 0; W2 and Wp scaled by 1/sqrt(2N)
other.embedding dims: d in {256,512,1024}; FF projects to 4d, or 2d for half-size
other.gradient checkpointing: attention and feed-forward blocks recomputed in backward pass
other.stopping: trained until validation error stops decreasing (CIFAR-10, Enwik8)

other.enwik8 eval: minimum context length varied by evaluating fewer tokens in parallel (Table 3)

metrics.name: bits per byte
metrics.definition: negative log2 likelihood per byte; equals bits per dim for image tasks

metrics.name: Time/Iter
metrics.definition: training time per iteration; unit not stated in the paper

eval.protocol: CIFAR-10 and Enwik8 reported over seeds 1,2,3; ImageNet single run; no direct comparison for audio

availability.code: GPU kernels implemented; release not stated in the paper

limits: Only density modeling (bits per byte); no downstream tasks
Strided pattern fails on text; fixed pattern costs c times more than strided
Sparse beating dense is attributed to inductive bias or an unexplained optimization issue with full attention
Audio data processing unavailable so no comparison with other work; sample quality degrades at greater lengths from reduced capacity
ImageNet result is a single run
Time/Iter unit and hardware for timing not stated; batch size, ImageNet/audio learning rates and layer counts for audio not stated
Fixed patterns cannot express the global and data-dependent patterns seen in dense models (Fig 2c,d)

terms.definition: one head attends to the previous l locations, the other to every lth location, l close to sqrt(n)
one head attends within its block of l; the other to the last c positions of each block, which summarize and propagate to all future cells
a single head attending to the union of the locations the factorized heads attend to
